div.head: Prom. Reg. 1
div.ab: ‘On þære halgan þrinnesse naman! Ic þreo þing beháte Cristenum folce ⁊ me underðeoddum:
Haec tria populo Christiano et mihi subdito in Christi promitto nomine:
On þære halgan þrinnesse naman! Ic þreo þing beháte Cristenum folce ⁊ me underðeoddum:
In the name of the Holy Trinity! I promise three things to the Christian people who are under my authority:
‘Im Namen der heiligen Dreieinigkeit! Ich verheisse dreierlei dem christlichen und mir untergebenen Volke:
‘In the name of the Holy Trinity! I promise three things to the Christian people subject to me:
